text: The Patriots head into their Week 8 showdown with Miami dealing with some notable injury concerns, particularly at the receiver position where A.J. Brown is questionable after missing the final two practices with both ankle and knee issues—the knee trouble representing a new development on top of his previous ankle injury. On the brighter side, the secondary is expected to be healthy and ready to go, which should provide some defensive stability against a Dolphins team looking to build momentum against the defending AFC champion Patriots. The good news for New England's offense is that quarterback Drake Maye has emerged as one of the league's most dangerous improvvisers, leading all QBs in passing yards on scramble drills this season, a trait the offense will likely need to lean on if they're forced to work without Brown's full availability on Sunday.
